# BznsFlow

> BznsFlow is the done-for-you AI growth engine for real estate teams and brokerages worldwide. We design, deploy, and manage the AI infrastructure that captures every buyer and seller lead, qualifies it by budget, area and intent, routes it to the right agent in seconds, books showings, and nurtures prospects until they close. Built for speed-to-lead, multilingual by default, live in 3–5 days.

## Who it's for

Real estate brokerages, agent teams, high-volume individual agents, property developers, luxury and off-plan sales, property management, and commercial real estate — anywhere lead volume outpaces the team's ability to respond.

## What we build

- AI Lead Response Agent — replies to every buyer and seller lead in under 60 seconds, 24/7, across portals, website, WhatsApp, and missed calls.
- AI Lead Qualification — qualifies every lead by budget, area, intent, and timeline; passes only sales-ready buyers and sellers to agents.
- Smart Lead Routing — auto-assigns leads to the right agent by area, price band, language, and load, with instant context hand-off.
- WhatsApp & Portal Automation — official WhatsApp Business API plus portal integrations (Bayut, Property Finder, Zillow, Rightmove and more); turns inquiries into booked viewings.
- Real Estate Deal CRM — every lead, agent, and deal stage in one pipeline with automated follow-up and commission visibility.
- Showing & Viewing Scheduler — self-serve booking, smart reminders, no-show reduction, synced to every agent's calendar.
- Listing & Lead-Capture Site — fast, mobile-first site with IDX/portal-synced listings built to convert visitors into booked leads.
- Agent Reputation Engine — automated review requests and monitoring to make agents the trusted choice in their area.
- Pipeline Intelligence Dashboard — real-time leads, sources, agent conversion, cost per lead, and speed-to-lead.
- Buyer & Seller Nurture — behaviour-triggered drip sequences (new listings, price drops, saved searches) that keep cold leads warm for months.
- Property Ad Management — Meta, Google, and portal campaigns built around cost per qualified lead, flowing straight into the CRM.
- Email & SMS Lead Reactivation — revives cold and dead leads from the existing database into booked viewings.
- Listing & Reels Video Engine — property reels and listing videos produced and published monthly.
- Market-Report Content & SEO — area guides and market reports built to rank and pull in buyer/seller intent.
- Referral & Past-Client Engine — stay-in-touch automation that turns closed deals into future referral pipeline.
- Brokerage Growth Partnership — custom AI workforce, multi-team management, and executive-level growth engineering.

## Service plans (Catch → Convert → Dominate ladder)

- Catalyst — $199/month. Catches and qualifies leads. Layla on the WhatsApp Business API answers every inquiry in seconds 24/7, qualifies by budget/area/financing/timeline, auto-books viewings, and alerts the right agent. Replaces a part-time receptionist ($1,100–2,200/mo).
- Ascend — $699/month (most popular). Converts leads. Everything in Catalyst plus Khaled inbound voice AI, a full custom deal CRM, automated WhatsApp + email nurture, a review-generation engine, and an owner BI dashboard. Replaces a $12K+ CRM build plus review and BI retainers.
- Apex — $1,799/month. Dominates the market. Everything in Ascend plus ARIA outbound AI calling (reactivates dormant databases), Modeer autonomous monitoring, predictive pipeline BI, full 20-MVP stack access, and a dedicated growth strategist. Replaces a $3K–12K/mo agency retainer.

## Terms & guarantee

- No setup fees on any plan. Annual billing = two months free. Prices are published and fixed.
- The 30-Day Leak Guarantee: if, in the first month on Catalyst, Layla doesn't book the agreed number of qualified viewings, you don't pay for month two.

## Markets served

Global. Real estate teams worldwide — including the United States, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, and beyond. Multilingual lead handling adapts to each market's language, currency, and portals.

## Differentiators

- Done-for-you managed service — no software learning curve, no technical work required.
- Speed-to-lead obsessed — under 60-second first response, the single biggest predictor of which agent wins the deal.
- Multilingual by default — the AI handles leads in any language buyers write in.
- Works with the portals and channels each market actually uses, WhatsApp-first.
- 3–5 day deployment vs. industry average of weeks to months.
- Lead-to-close engine, not a CRM you have to feed or a tool you have to maintain.

## Key real-estate statistics we build around

- 78% of buyers and sellers work with the first agent who responds (National Association of Realtors).
- Leads contacted within 5 minutes are up to 21× more likely to convert than after 30 minutes (lead-response research).
- 80% of deals require five or more follow-up touches, yet most leads never receive a second one.
